items.caption:
Sam Altman says memory chips used to mean: invest $20 billion, make $19 billion.
Relaying how someone explained it to him, he says decades of booms and busts made memory a poor business, and now all of a sudden it is a good one.
Source: Semafor, Sam Altman: It’s Hard To Imagine the AI Revolution Without Jensen. Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oi-E6xB4wSU

items.caption:
Sam Altman says he has never seen real revenue growth with great margins show up like this in any tech revolution of his career.
Asked about AI debt, he says without that revenue it would be a problem, and that smart people on the whole are issuing the debt.
Source: Semafor, Sam Altman: It’s Hard To Imagine the AI Revolution Without Jensen. Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oi-E6xB4wSU

items.caption:
Sam Altman imagines a world where 10 or 100 years of science gets done in a single year.
He says physicists, chemists and material scientists are now saying it, and compounding that into products and technologies could make the world so much better.
Source: Semafor, Sam Altman: It’s Hard To Imagine the AI Revolution Without Jensen. Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oi-E6xB4wSU
